text.p: Andersons Inc, an agribusiness company, said Monday it foresees an "excellent" second quarter, with acreage increases for both corn and soybeans.

Mike Anderson, president and chief operating officer, issued the forecast as the company reported a net loss of $4.1 million or $0.49 a share for the first quarter of 1997 on revenues of $186.million, 27 percent below the $256.7 million posted in the similar period last year.
"With the first quarter traditionally a soft period for our grain and retail businesses, we expected a loss for the first threee months of 1997," he said.
The first quarter was particularly tough because of current agricultural conditions in certain parts of its region, resulting in the second year of poor crops, he said.

Chief Executive Dick Anderson added: "While our grain business will continue to struggle throughout the first nine months of 1997 becuase we simply have fewer bushels available in our region until the next harvest, I am optimistic about the company's overall outlook for the current quarter and the full year."
